title: Central logged an unexplained 500 from the Mac federation peer during post-restart re-attestation (8d838f90)
outcome: The single 500 that the central host logged from Mac peer abf8bda6 after the 8d838f90 restart is tied to a route and a host and classified with evidence; a product defect, if any, has its own fix item.
acceptance: The 500 is tied to a specific route and to the host that produced it, with its log line or response body quoted.
Its cause is classified as transient restart or enrollment behaviour, remote-host state, or a product defect, with evidence; a product defect gets its own fix item.
